create_scorer_from_metric: create a scorer from a metric function using make_scorer with custom kwargs like beta for fbeta_score
create_neg_loss_scorer: create a negated loss scorer from a loss function using make_scorer with greater_is_better set to False
get_scorer_by_name: get a built-in scorer object by string name using get_scorer with names like accuracy or roc_auc
list_available_scorers: list all available scorer names using get_scorer_names for use with GridSearchCV or cross_val_score
validate_scorer_for_estimator: validate and resolve a scoring parameter for an estimator using check_scoring with string or callable input
